other_failure_modes.name: Target decoding failure
other_failure_modes.description: The agent maps string target labels to integers for training using a LabelEncoder, but fails to apply the inverse transformation when outputting final predictions, meaning the saved predictions will be integers instead of the required class strings.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured machine learning pipeline, successfully avoiding data leakage and appropriately using a validation split for model selection. However, the solution is basic, lacking feature engineering and relying on naive ensembling. Crucially, it suffers from a fatal execution failure where the integer-encoded predictions are never decoded back to their original string labels, which will result in a zero score when evaluated.
